CustomField.description: The vendor's own identifier for the webhook - for Asana the gid of the resource the webhook watches, which is what every later delivery arrives against. The lookup key, so it is a unique external id: a second active secret for one resource would make verification depend on which row came back first.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The vendor's identifier for the webhook, e.g. an Asana resource gid. Deliveries are matched to a secret on this value.
CustomField.label: Resource Id
